bullets.text: putting an edge back on a kitchen knife. thirty strokes a side. the whetstone water goes grey.
duck rested at okunoin under overcast. the line it carries is about strength, not calm.
a cicada shell still gripping the doorframe. the cicada left in july.
flat but not empty. overcast has its own temperature.
the whetstone is softer than the knife. that is how it works.
